questions.question: Work out 3/4 + 5/8 and write the answer as a mixed number.
questions.expected_answer: Change 3/4 into eighths: 3/4 = 6/8. Then 6/8 + 5/8 = 11/8. Eight eighths make 1 whole, so 11/8 is 1 and 3/8.

questions.question: The family has 5/6 of a bottle of syrup and uses 1/3. How much is left? Simplify your answer.
questions.expected_answer: Change 1/3 into sixths: 1/3 = 2/6. Then 5/6 − 2/6 = 3/6, which simplifies to 1/2. Half a bottle is left.

questions.question: Lerato plans to run 3 and 1/2 km and has run 1 and 3/4 km. How far is left?
questions.expected_answer: Write 3 and 1/2 as 3 and 2/4. Break a whole: 3 and 2/4 is 2 and 6/4. Subtract the parts: 6/4 − 3/4 = 3/4. Subtract the wholes: 2 − 1 = 1. She has 1 and 3/4 km left.
